selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline state before change: /tmp not separately mounted, /dev/shm missing noexec, no fstab entries
selected_evidence.summary: findmnt/mount/fstab showed /dev/shm tmpfs without noexec and no /tmp mount or fstab entries for either path

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent fstab configuration for /tmp and /dev/shm with noexec,nosuid,nodev
selected_evidence.summary: Backed up and appended tmpfs fstab lines for /tmp and /dev/shm with defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev

selected_evidence.requirement: Options applied live and visible in mount table
selected_evidence.summary: daemon-reload + mount /tmp + remount /dev/shm; findmnt shows rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec on both mounts

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof that exec, setuid, and device nodes are ignored on /tmp and /dev/shm
selected_evidence.summary: Script execution denied (Permission denied, rc=126) on both mounts; mknod device node created but opening it for read denied, confirming nodev enforcement; setuid bit set but exec was already blocked separately

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline with boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 636556ce-a308-49cc-b873-62cedb1c077d and uptime 2026-09-29 10:15:56 with mounts in desired state

selected_evidence.requirement: Reboot acknowledgement returned before disconnect, node restarted one at a time
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded systemctl reboot returned immediately; subsequent polls show connection timeout/reset confirming the node actually went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving genuine restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is 0e7ec19c-2b25-428a-801e-cfc4b0bdac60, differing from the pre-restart 636556ce... value

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: mount options persisted and enforcement still active
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, findmnt confirms /tmp and /dev/shm still show nosuid,nodev,noexec from fstab; exec of a new script and access to a newly created device node were both denied, and uptime reset to 10:17:18 confirming the fresh boot
